mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.user_id) + CASE WHEN m.host_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM tl_meeting_participants WHERE meetings_id = #{meetingsId}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as total_count FROM tl_meetings m LEFT JOIN tl_meeting_participants p ON m.meetings_id = p.meetings_id WHERE m.meetings_id = #{meetingsId}

SELECT meeting_participants_id, meetings_id, user_id, role, joined_at, left_at FROM tl_meeting_participants WHERE meetings_id = #{meetingsId} ORDER BY meeting_participants_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT meeting_participants_id, meetings_id, user_id, role, joined_at, left_at FROM tl_meeting_participants WHERE meetings_id = #{meetingsId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tl_meeting_participants (meetings_id, user_id, role) VALUES (#{meetingsId}, #{userId}, #{role}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE role = VALUES(role)
mapper.select: SELECT p.meeting_participants_id, p.meetings_id, p.user_id, p.role, p.joined_at, p.left_at, u.name as user_name, u.email as user_email, u.profile_image_url as user_profile_image_url, u.locale as user_locale FROM tl_meeting_participants p INNER JOIN tl_users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.meetings_id = #{meetingsId} ORDER BY CASE p.role WHEN 'HOST' THEN 1 WHEN 'GUEST' THEN 2 WHEN 'VIEWER' THEN 3 END, p.joined_at ASC
